title: Edit profile
needLogin: You need to sign in to edit your profile.
fileTooBig: The file is too large (max 4 MB)
formMissing: The form is not loaded — reload the page

create.title: Become a streamer
create.hint: Pick a name — people will find you by it (your page will be at /streamers/name, in lowercase).
create.name: Streamer name

tool.link: Link button (a photo can be added later)
tool.bg: Page background: up to 2 backgrounds and a transition between them

phone.live: This is how the stream looks on a phone: player on top, chat below (custom layout works from 900 px)
phone.profile: This is how the profile looks on a phone (view only)

infoLive: · No scissors on the live page, photos are background only
polyNoLink: A freehand shape can't be turned into a button
liveNoShape: On the live page a block without a photo can only be text or a button
avatarAbove: The avatar always stays above the banner
badUrl: The link must start with http:// or https://

resetConfirm.title: Reset the layout?
resetConfirm.text: All your custom blocks will be removed, the default ones will return to their places.

m.photoIntoShape: 🖼 Put a photo into the shape
m.label: Label
m.playerHint: The player can be scaled up or down by at most 10%. The chat height follows.
m.chatHint: The chat can be widened, its height equals the player height.

fit.title: 🎯 How to show the photo
fit.cropped: part of the photo is cropped, choose which part to show
fit.hint: Drag the photo to choose what to show. The mouse wheel changes the zoom. The dimmed part won't be in the block.

cntHint: Hover to highlight where they are on the page; click to pin the highlight
widthGuide: Profile width is {w} now. Drag a block further right and the page gets wider (up to 1760)

bg.title: Page background
bg.hint: The background lies under all profile blocks. Pick a color or a photo, then add a second background and a smooth transition between them.
bg.posHint: While this menu is open, a dashed line on the stage shows where the transition is.
bg.profileOnly: Only the profile has a background
bg.sidesHint: Left and right of the profile, the full window height (they don’t scroll). For a 1920×1080 screen a photo of about {w}×{h} px per side fits now. On other screens the photo adjusts itself: “Fill” crops the extra, “Whole” shows all of it.
bg.sidesNarrow: The profile is almost as wide as a 1920 screen — the sides will barely show. Make the profile narrower (move blocks left) to make room for them.
bg.fullOn: The background covers the whole page below the site header; a photo is pinned to the window and doesn’t stretch as you scroll. The stage shows only the part under the profile — use “👁 View on the page”.
bg.fullOff: The background is only under the profile, as on the stage. Around it — the site color or the page sides.

preview.hint: The full-page background and the sides show only on the profile page itself. The preview opens in a new tab and follows your edits — no need to save.
preview.blocked: The browser blocked the new tab — allow pop-ups for this site

page.widthHint: The profile is {w} wide now. “By blocks” — up to the right edge of the rightmost block; a number — that width right away, even if the right part is still empty. The wider the profile, the narrower the sides.
